patch_description:
This version replaces the square-constrained search with a triangular convex hull, which is more compatible with the known geometry of strong Heilbronn-type configurations. It uses a deterministic 3-fold-symmetric differential-evolution stage to efficiently locate high-quality global arrangements, followed by an unconstrained sparse local polish of the ten non-hull points.

The hull is an equilateral triangle rescaled to have exactly unit area, so the minimum raw triangle area equals the normalized objective. The differential-evolution population includes periodic diversity replacement, preventing premature collapse into nearly identical layouts. All random choices use a fixed seed and all candidate points are projected back into the triangular region.
